record.hypothesis: For all four datasets, reduce each HSTU residual FFN expansion from 4*hidden_units to 2*hidden_units, keeping its SiLU activation, dropout and residual path. Predominantly short histories may benefit from a smaller FFN that reduces overfitting while preserving causal gated attention. Retain the existing attention-output gate rather than repeating the unsuccessful token-conditioned gate experiment. Keep features, embeddings, sequence/readout policy, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed; update checkpoint construction and generated prediction consistently.

category_rationales.rationale: Reduce every HSTU residual FFN expansion from 4× to 2× hidden width across all four category models to test whether lower capacity reduces overfitting on short histories. Preserve SiLU, dropout, residual paths, attention-output gates and all other settings. The generated predictor imports HSTURec from train.py, so it constructs matching checkpoint shapes without writer changes.
